item.tib: sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las shar phyogs dur khrod mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / ma sring gnyen la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba rnam dag mthus/ bdag sogs 'gro ba thams cad kun/ phyi mar o rgyan gnas mchog tu/ brdzus te skye ba len par shog kha ba can ljongs bod yul du/ bstan pa dar rgyas bkra shis shog/
